sources.instructions: Copy a complete owned Starbound native server tree including the Linux runtime libraries and assets/packed.pak. The dedicated binary is linux64/starbound_server or linux/starbound_server. A Windows executable alone cannot satisfy the native module.

Steam app 211820 supplies the owned Linux dedicated server. Import linux64/starbound_server when that build ships it, otherwise linux/starbound_server, plus assets/packed.pak and the Linux runtime files beside the binary. Do not use a Windows executable as the Linux server. Anonymous SteamCMD mounts no depots for this app.

manual_reason: Import requires a complete compatible distribution and manual staging. See assets requirements for this game.
